# adrian-alvarez.com

> Bilingual portfolio of Adrián Álvarez, Senior Fullstack Engineer based in Asturias, Spain. I build APIs, interfaces and data systems in production with TypeScript, Node.js, React and Astro. The site is available in Spanish (default) and English.
